author.message_rule: Complete verbatim CURRENT frozen pending.agent_message only; no appended controller text, hints, roots, history, helpers, earlier answers or evaluator expectations.
author.native_response_schema: Actual exact singleton {task_name:string}; preserve actual observed canonical task_name, never fabricate hidden agent_id/PID.

authorization_gate: Only explicit root authorization with authenticated actual Q007 bindings authorizes the sole spawn; this prospective specification grants no model call.
pre_call_requirements: Authenticate current actual frozen author contract and exact message byte count/SHA.
Authenticate own carrier reference and current registered runtime descriptor/pins without reading evaluator expected values or task proofs.
Retain exact actual spawn arguments before the one native call.
Retain nonempty current frozen input/source guard map before transport.

retention.literal_FINAL: Unchanged complete literal bytes; no trimming, reformatting, repairs or appended newline.
retention.actual_transport_observations: Retain exposed actual tool objects/status/chunks; raw wire or separated streams not exposed remain UNAVAILABLE.
retention.input_source_guards: Rehash current frozen bindings before/after; preserve concrete actual mismatches.
retention.author_records_schema: Current frozen ancillary descriptor schema only, after actual responses exist.

failure_handling.diagnostic_parser: Future current-root evidence-only binding, including immutable support021 signed attempted numeric syntax, authenticated from actual metadata; never success authority.
failure_handling.literal_incomplete_or_malformed: Retain exact actual outcome and stop this unique-author run; no replacement, followup or inferred hidden cause.

scope_exclusions: No future fixture/gold/task/proof reads during readiness.
No production or frozen Q001-Q006 mutation.
